item.title: Castleview Hospital welcomes first baby of 2026
item.description: PRICE — On Jan. 1, 2026, Castleview Hospital rang in the new year with the hospital’s first baby, Natalia Alvarado. Natalia was born to Victoria and Francisco (Cisco) Alvarado at 9:46 a.m., weighing 6 lbs. 5.5 oz. and measuring 19 inches.
